# awscc_sagemaker_code_repository (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::CodeRepository



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `git_config` (Attributes) Configuration details for the Git repository, including the URL where it is located and the ARN of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that contains the credentials used to access the repository. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git_config))

### Optional

- `code_repository_name` (String) The name of the Git repository.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `code_repository_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the code repository.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--git_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git_config`

Required:

- `repository_url` (String) The URL where the Git repository is located.

Optional:

- `branch` (String) The default branch for the Git repository.
- `secret_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that contains the credentials used to access the git repository.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_code_repository.example
  identity = {
    code_repository_arn = "code_repository_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `code_repository_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the code repository

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_code_repository.example
  id = "code_repository_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_sagemaker_code_repository.example "code_repository_arn"
```
